title: Pure Witchcrafter
summary: Pure Witchcrafter build featuring the Endymion maids (which are always treated as Witchcrafter cards) alongside generic staples. Low-Level Witchcrafters Tribute themselves as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase and discard a Spell to Special Summon any Witchcrafter from the Deck, while Witchcrafter Spells in the GY return to the hand during your End Phase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Witchcrafter Schmietta, Witchcrafter Pittore, Witchcrafter Potterie, and Witchcrafter Genni each Tribute themselves during either Main Phase and discard a Spell to Special Summon a Witchcrafter monster from the Deck.
Verre, the Maid of Endymion (always treated as a Witchcrafter card) Special Summons itself after a Spell resolves and searches a Witchcrafter Spell or Trap.
Genni, the Maid of Endymion (always treated as a Witchcrafter card) Special Summons itself alongside a Spellcaster and banishes a Spellcaster to Special Summon a Witchcrafter from the Deck.
Witchcrafter Creation searches any Witchcrafter monster from the Deck and returns to the hand from the GY in the End Phase if not activated that turn.

summary.title: Opening: Witchcrafter Schmietta + Any Spell
steps: Normal Summon Witchcrafter Schmietta, Tribute it as a Quick Effect, and discard a Witchcrafter Spell to Special Summon Witchcrafter Haine or Witchcrafter Madame Verre from the Deck.
Banish Schmietta from the GY to send a Witchcrafter Spell (such as Witchcrafter Holiday, Witchcrafter Bystreet, or Witchcrafter Confusion Confession) or Witchcrafter Genni from the Deck to the GY.

In the End Phase, return every Witchcrafter Spell that was not activated this turn from the GY to the hand (or place Bystreet/Scroll onto the field) to fuel Haine and Madame Verre on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: End Phase Spell Recursion & Graveyard Effects
summary.text: Witchcrafter Creation, Holiday, Unveiling, Draping, and Confusion Confession all return from the GY to your hand during your End Phase if you control a Witchcrafter monster and did not activate that Spell by name that turn (while Bystreet and Scroll place themselves face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone). In addition, Witchcrafter Genni banishes itself and a Witchcrafter Spell from the GY to copy that Spell's effect, Pittore banishes itself to draw and discard, and Potterie recovers a Witchcrafter card when your hand is empty.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Witchcrafter Vice-Madame, Fusion Summoned via Witchcrafter Confusion Confession, triggers up to three non-repeating effects per turn whenever a Spell Card or non-Fusion Spellcaster effect activates: destroy a card on the field, Special Summon a Level 6 or lower Witchcrafter from the hand or Deck, or add a Witchcrafter Spell/Trap from the GY to the hand.

Witchcrafter Madame Verre discards a Spell as a Quick Effect to negate the effects of all face-up monsters the opponent currently controls for the turn, and reveals distinct Spells in your hand during damage calculation to boost your battling Spellcaster by 1000 ATK/DEF per Spell.
Witchcrafter Haine discards a Spell as a Quick Effect to destroy a face-up card the opponent controls and prevents the opponent from targeting your other Spellcasters with card effects.
Witchcrafter Golem Aruru Special Summons itself from the hand when the opponent targets your Spellcaster or attacks it, bouncing a card from the opponent's field or a Witchcrafter Spell from your GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The OCG-exclusive Witchcrafter cards (Marka, Seed, Terracottan, Celebration, Walpurgis, Distortion, Madame Rilliona, and Pupils) are excluded until they release in the TCG.
